title: National Database and Registration Authority Amendment Ordinance 2009

sections.shortTitle: National Database and Registration Authority Amendment Ordinance 2009
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ORDINANCE LIX OF 2009
ORDINANCE LIX OF 2009
NATIONAL DATABASE AND
REGISTRATION AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2009
An Ordinance further to amend
the National Database and Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I,
5th December,' 2009]
No.2(I)/2009-Pub., dated
5-12-2009.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the National
Database and Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000 (VIII of 2000),for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is not in session
and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it
necessary to take immediate action.
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred
by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Ordinance:--
1. Short title, extent and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be called the National Database and Registration Authority
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2009.
(2) It shall come into force at once and shall be
deemed to have taken effect on the 17th September, 2007.
